title: A counterexample to metric-entropy duality

result.label: A counterexample to metric-entropy duality
result.statement: Disproves Pietsch's dimension-free duality conjecture for metric entropy. Origin-symmetric convex bodies violate every proposed choice of universal constants in the conjectured comparison between covering numbers and those of the polar bodies, even when the covering body is a cube.
